detail: Escalated: rubric 'no dead/placeholder links' conflicts with characterization tests that deliberately pin the Hero bottom-nav (#enterprise/#ai-audit/#saas/#consulting) and Footer Products/Legal ('#') placeholder hrefs — resolving/removing them requires editing the behaviour contract, so it routes through ba-change (REFACTOR_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE). The independent, behaviour-preserving architecture standard (single src/config source of truth for external integrations) was applied: added src/config/site.ts and de-hard-coded the WhatsApp number in Contact.tsx. Full suite stayed green-to-green (22/22) and tsc --noEmit is clean. See .claude/status/escalation.md.

escalation.reason: Rubric convention 'No dead or placeholder links' conflicts with green characterization tests that pin the current placeholder hrefs in Hero (F-003) and Footer (F-012). Satisfying the rubric would require editing those characterization tests, i.e. an observable behaviour change.
